detail.longDescription: I built a blog from scratch. Custom markdown renderer, photo gallery, all that kind of stuff. Now my non tech friend asked me if she can haz the same. Thinking. How to make easy but upgradeable? Hmm? Am I building a proof of concept of how # GitHub pages can self host a bare bones repo with not much more than bunch of markdown files, some images and one configuration yaml so that a “fork” button is enough to start publishing? Yep I am…
